## File: berriai_litellm/litellm/llms/zai/chat/transformation.py

Prompts

```
['get the list of supported OpenAI parameters for a ZAI chat model', 'get the API base URL and API key for ZAI chat configuration', 'preserve cache_control flags in messages and tools for ZAI chat completion', "get the custom LLM provider identifier as 'zai'", 'build a ZAIChatConfig instance to configure OpenAI-compatible ZAI API calls']
```

```
{'get_supported_openai_params': 'get the list of supported OpenAI parameters for a ZAI chat model', 'get_openai_compatible_provider_info': 'get the API base URL and API key for ZAI chat configuration', 'remove_cache_control_flag_from_messages_and_tools': 'preserve cache_control flags in messages and tools for ZAI chat completion', 'custom_llm_provider': "get the custom LLM provider identifier as 'zai'", 'build_zai_chat_config': 'build a ZAIChatConfig instance to configure OpenAI-compatible ZAI API calls'}
```
